items.title: Janis Siegel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 2015
items.q: I mean influenced certainly by Lambert, Hendricks & Ross and Jon in particular.

ctx.x: Well you know we’ve been doing his stuff from the very beginning honestly. And certainly we were aware of vocalese. For the first album Tim and I wrote a vocalese to “You Can Depend on Me” in the style — I mean influenced certainly by Lambert, Hendricks & Ross and Jon in particular. But we didn’t really meet Jon and start a relationship until “Birdland” happened. We had originally commissioned Eddie Jefferson

to write the lyric. And Eddie was murdered tragically. And after a time went by we asked his widow if he had left anything behind in his papers, any start of a lyric or any — and she said no. So we called Jon and that was that. That was the beginning of a beautiful friendship. And he’s very dear to us.
